intro.fr: The Henry Stickmin Collection se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: The Henry Stickmin Collection can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub funjeff/HenryStickminArchipelagoIntegration, qui héberge l'APWorld de The Henry Stickmin Collection.
text.en: The GitHub repository funjeff/HenryStickminArchipelagoIntegration, home of the The Henry Stickmin Collection APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, prototype version.
text.en: The first version, prototype version, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version 0.5, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (9 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 0.5 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (9 versions released).

text.fr: The Henry Stickmin Collection figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: The Henry Stickmin Collection is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
